messages:
Sam (Support): Escalating pilot issue for LanternAI: large CSV upload jobs hitting ingest rate limits, ~30% of rows failing. Customer is mid-pilot, renewal conversation in 2 weeks. @Rina plz own. :exclamation:
Rina (CS): Ack. Need owner, quick mitigation, and comms. Is this quota or a regression?
Diego (Solutions): Likely rate cap hit on embed ingestion path after traffic spike. Sam, paste a sample error and tenant id.
Sam (Support): Logs:
```
[2026-09-02T08:14:22Z] ingest: batch_upload failed tenant=lantern-tenant-9 error=429 body="ingest_rate_exceeded" batch_id=bf9c
[2026-09-02T08:14:23Z] retry: attempt=1 result=429
```
Repro: large import via web UI -> 429 consistently for batches >500 rows. Ticket 88211.
Rina (CS): Ok. Short comms plan: 1) immediate ack to customer + temporary pause guidance 2) manual smaller-batch workaround 3) request emergency quota bump to infra for pilot window 4) schedule 30m enablement to walk import template. Owner=Eli, tech lead=Diego.
Eli (Account): I'll own comms. Drafting now. Will offer to run imports for them while we sort infra. Can we do a one-off quota bump for 4 hours?
Diego (Solutions): Two mitigation options: A) soft-fail -> queue retries with exponential backoff (fast fix, code change), B) infra quota bump (service-side, fast if approved). I'll open a support request to infra and prototype client-side retry in parallel.
ingest-bot: Runbook: ingest 429 -> https://redwood.ops/ingest-rate-limit-runbook (link)
Rina (CS): Action items in-thread: Eli send comms in 15m, Diego request infra bump and provide telemetry, Sam add failed row sample and import file link, Rina schedule 30m enablement. Renewal-flag=true until imports confirmed.
Sam (Support): Uploaded sample file to ticket and linked it here. 20% of rows have non-deterministic failures (some succeed on retry).
Eli (Account): Sent initial email to LanternAI (10:25): "We've seen your import hit ingestion limits. Short-term: please split into <=200-row batches or we can run it for you. We're asking our infra team for temporary capacity while we fix client-side retries." Waiting for response.
Diego (Solutions): Infra confirmed receipt. Requested +2x pilot throughput for tenant lantern-tenant-9 for 4h. PR #1228 created with client retry patch, demoed locally.
Sam (Support): Quick update 10:52: infra approved +2x throughput for 3h. I triggered the bump. Monitoring imports now.
Rina (CS): Great. Eli, offer a 30m screenshare to run the remaining imports together. Diego follow up on PR and ETA for deploy. Sam monitor errors and collect success counts.
Eli (Account): Screenshare booked 11:00. Customer accepted and asked for better onboarding molasses: clearer guidance on import sizing and a preflight checker. Capturing as feedback.
Diego (Solutions): Deploying retry patch to canary now; ETA 45m. Will add a small preflight check in the importer to warn on large batches.
Sam (Support): After bump + manual assists, remaining import succeeded (final success rate 99.6%). Ticket 88211 updated and linked to thread.
Rina (CS): Closing loop: immediate risk mitigated, renewal risk downgraded. Outstanding: add preflight checker to docs and UI, postmortem + follow-up comms. Owner for doc updates = Rina. ETA 4 business days. Thanks team. :handshake:
